caption: A long serpentine arrangement of upright white dominoes lies folded into parallel rows across a pale marble floor, with a single black domino resting on a stepped white base at the near-left end. An extended index finger presses the black domino, tilting it forward until it lies flat against the base. The first white dominoes on the stepped base tip in sequence, and the hand withdraws out of frame. A falling wave travels rightward along the bottom straight row, each tile toppling its neighbor. The collapse reaches the curved right end and reverses, propagating leftward along the middle row. As that row approaches the left curve, it tips the top row, which falls over from left to right. The not-yet-reached sections of the top row and the far-right tail remain upright, marking the boundary of the traveling collapse. The chain reaction is still underway when the clip ends.
